headline: Swiss vote on the Neutrality Initiative
deck: A more restrictive neutrality text would block the country from imposing economic sanctions or cooperating with NATO.
body: Swiss citizens vote on 27 September 2026 on the Federal Popular Initiative titled “Safeguard Swiss neutrality (Neutrality Initiative).” [E1]
Voters decide on Sunday whether to approve a more restrictive form of neutrality that would block the country from imposing economic sanctions or cooperating with NATO. [E2]
They are deciding the fate of two popular initiatives this weekend. [E3]
